character_facts: Aghora is capable of executing a highly precise laser attack against a colossal target.
Bushitaka is presented as an authority whose strategic decree guides this action.
continuity_links: This page continues an ongoing confrontation at the interdimensional gateway site.
The narration suggests Aghora's move is a direct implementation of Bushitaka's established teaching.
dialogue_meaning: The narration frames the attack as the application of Bushitaka's doctrine for defeating a vastly larger foe.
The page explains that Aghora's attack is a precise decapitation-like strike aimed at the enemy's command center rather than a conventional battle.
The final narration identifies the target as the mother-brain and states that its pineal gland is exposed by the laser cut.
locations: The place where dwellers from another dimension opened a gateway to this universe
Outer space or a cosmic battlefield surrounding the enemy mother-brain
lore_facts: Dwellers from another dimension have opened a gateway into this universe.
Bushitaka is associated with a combat doctrine about defeating oversized enemies by targeting the equivalent of the head.
The enemy has a 'mother-brain' that functions as a critical central structure.
The mother-brain has a pineal gland that can be physically exposed by a precise strike.
plot_events: The scene shifts to the site where beings from another dimension opened a gateway into this universe.
A tactical principle attributed to Bushitaka is invoked: defeat an overwhelmingly large enemy by severing its 'head' rather than fighting it head-on.
Aghora fires or uses a precision laser to slice through the enemy's mother-brain.
The strike exposes the mother-brain's pineal gland amid an explosive rupture.
uncertainties: No speaking characters are visibly shown; Bushitaka appears only in narration and Aghora may be off-panel.
Some caption text is small and partially difficult to read, so wording may be slightly imprecise.
The exact physical form of the enemy anatomy is unclear beyond being a massive brainlike mother-brain with a vulnerable gland.
visual_summary: A cosmic double-page spread shows an immense organic-mechanical enemy mass in space. A narrow, bright beam cuts through the huge brainlike body and neck-like connection to a spherical head or core, while energy arcs and debris burst outward. The composition emphasizes a surgical strike against the creature’s central mind.
